answer: Cluster weight is set by its knoll, the minimum settled tenure across every key sharing one funding root, so a farm cannot forge standing with addresses. The vertex of each cluster is its first staked deposit, never the label a key claims. Each new key escrows 400 POA for 6 epochs, and while it holds zero tenure the whole cluster weighs zero, so the tenth clone erases the nine before it. Bond sums across members while weight stays pinned to the weakest, so cost per unit of weight is super-linear. One failed peer audit slashes every bond in that cluster jointly and burns the holdback.
